findings.title: Stage path on touch devices: unit squares become 28x44 bars and capstone diamonds render as skewed slashes
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-ipad.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone.png; eval at iphone: .k-cx-dia offsetWidth 16 x offsetHeight 44 with transform rotate(45deg); .k-cx-sq 28x44. css/base.css:115-119 (coarse min-block-size: var(--hit-coarse) on every button) vs css/views/code.css:132,137 (fixed inline-size/block-size), buttons made at js/core/codeui.js:556,567
findings.rootCause: The global coarse-pointer rule raises min-block-size of every <button> to 44px (invariant 69) but the path's square/diamond buttons only set inline-size/block-size, so height grows and width does not; the diamond is then rotated.
findings.fix: Give .k-cx-sq and .k-cx-dia min-block-size: 0 (they are visual marks; the diamond is tabindex -1) and put the 44px hit area on a transparent ::before or wrapper, or raise width with height for the squares (invariant 69: a round/square control must raise its width too).

findings.title: iPhone desk: Daily 20 and Continue squeezed side by side; the Open-lesson button's label spills out of its pill
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone-d20.png (dpr 2), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone.png; eval iphone: [data-ui=code.daily20-lesson] 144x44, scrollWidth 153, white-space nowrap; .k-cx-d20 width 180. css/views/study.css:1074-1076 (side becomes a row of flex:1 1 0 cards), button at js/modules/code.js:221-223
findings.rootCause: The phone/compact rule lays the side column as a row of two equal cards whatever their width; k-btn is nowrap with no max-inline-size or ellipsis, and the label names the lesson in full.
findings.fix: Under 560px stack the two side cards (flex-direction: column) or fold Continue into the Daily 20 card when the Daily 20's job is 'Finish 1.1 first' (they point at the same lesson). Shorten the button to 'Open 1.1' or allow wrapping/ellipsis (.k-fit-btn).

findings.title: Desk side column: a real Daily 20 task crushes the Continue card to 41px and clips its 'CONTINUE' label (Mac, iPad landscape)

findings.rootCause: The side column is size-contained to the hero's height and its children may shrink to zero with overflow hidden; the Daily 20 card (first child, flex 1 1 auto) takes what it needs, so the second card is what gives way and is clipped rather than the layout growing.
findings.fix: Give the Continue card flex: 0 0 auto (never shrink below its content) and let the Daily 20 card scroll/clip instead, or drop size containment when the content is taller than the hero; render concept chips as one non-wrapping scroller or limit to two chips + '+1'.

findings.title: Task Run can only feed ONE line of input: a correct answer to any multi-line task crashes with ArgumentNullException
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/code-space/task-run-multiline-mac.png; eval: set editor to KOS.code.task('2.9-guess').answer, click Run -> output 'ArgumentNullException line 5'; Object.values(KOS_CODE.TASKS) with multi-line examples[0].stdin = 158. js/modules/code.js:633-635 (input type text, split first line), :694 (stdin: stdin.value)
findings.rootCause: Run's input was built as a one-line text field and deliberately truncates the example to its first line; an <input> cannot hold newlines.
findings.fix: Use an auto-growing <textarea> (rows = example line count) prefilled with the whole first example stdin; keep Ctrl+Enter to run. Optionally a menu to load example N.

findings.title: Subject analytics card stretches its eight tiles over the Retrieval-due list's height, leaving ~120px gaps between rows

findings.title: SQL tasks: a slow first SQLite load fails a correct answer as an infinite loop, and the kill makes every retry cold again

Code: js/core/coderun.js:199-203 (timeout → sqlKill → next run fresh), :174-177; js/core/codeui.js:256-257 (hard-coded '2 seconds' and loop advice for every timeout); js/data/code.js:424
